subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: I was about to delete this feature when something happened at 2AM that made me keep it. You need to know why.
body_paragraphs: I almost deleted the calorie calculator from PupShape at 1:47 AM last Tuesday. I was exhausted, staring at code that felt pointless. Then my phone buzzed. It was a notification from the app—a user's dog had just hit its first weight milestone. That notification was the reason I was awake.

Here's the confession: I built the calorie calculator because of my own dog, Baxter. I'd been overfeeding him for months, thinking 'just a little more' was love. The vet said he was borderline obese. I felt that guilt you're probably familiar with—the one that keeps you up at night wondering if you're doing right by your best friend. At 2AM, researching pet nutrition, I realized every source gave different numbers. No wonder we're all confused.

That's why the calorie calculator in PupShape doesn't just spit out numbers. It accounts for breed quirks, age slowdowns, and even treat loopholes most owners miss. I built it after that sleepless night, coding until sunrise because I needed it for Baxter. It's the feature that prevents the 'slow creep' of extra pounds.

Open the app right now and check your dog's daily calorie target. Just tap 'Meal Plan' and you'll see it. I want you to have the clarity I didn't. P.S. Baxter lost 18% of his body weight using this exact calculator. The before/after photos still get me emotional.
